title: Procedural Preview Infinite World
description: Extract brep kernel into @geometry/brep/js, setup @procedural/react flow-based brep editor with R3F viewport, and @procedural/play playground.
summary: Fixed procedural 3D viewport navigation (pan/zoom/orbit). Root causes: WorldOrbitGated did not pass camera={camera} to OrbitControls (unlike puzzle 3d OrbitGated), so controls could bind to the wrong/default camera behind WorldOrbitCameraViewRig; WorldOrbitCameraViewRigSeed skipped re-seeding when the rig camera remounted with the same seed token; orbit-end React setCamera feedback fought live controls; preview host className overrode absolute fill layout; wheel guard now attaches to the WebGL canvas. Also kept canvas window body registration and removed domElement override.
